description: McAfee Network Security Manager (NSM) is the management console for McAfee Network Security Platform IPS. The NSM gives admins control and real-time data, so that they can manage, configure, and monitor NSP. The NSM Application Crypto Module provides cryptographic services for the Network Security Manager application.
